candidate.text: Feature Flag Promotions / Deprecations: cert-manager's feature flags allow for easier testing and adoption of new features with a reduced risk of breaking changes. In cert-manager v1.17, two feature gates have been promoted to "beta", and as such are now enabled by default in all installations: - `NameConstraints`, allowing users to specify the name constraints extension which can be helpful when creating CA certificates for private PKI - `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer`, which stops a Kubernetes warning from being printed in logs In addition, we added a new feature gate: `CAInjectorMerging`, which intelligently combines certificates used by the `CAInjector` component, making it safer to use when issuing certificates are rotated. If you're making heavy use of the CA injector, you should consider enabling this feature gate. Finally, we deprecated the `ValidateCAA` feature gate which will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0. This feature gate aimed to validate the `CAA` DNS record during ACME issuance, but has seen low adoption and limited testing since its introduction back in 2019.

### Feature Flag Promotions / Deprecations

cert-manager's feature flags allow for easier testing and adoption of new features with a reduced risk of breaking changes. In cert-manager v1.17, two feature gates have been promoted to "beta", and as such are now enabled by default in all installations:

- `NameConstraints`, allowing users to specify the name constraints extension which can be helpful when creating CA certificates for private PKI
- `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer`, which stops a Kubernetes warning from being printed in logs
